name: Go
description: Go's simple syntax, interfaces, goroutines and channels, and building production network services.

nodes.name: Go basics
nodes.desc: Packages, variables, functions, control flow and the zero value.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write simple Go programs using packages, variables, functions and control flow, relying on zero values for initialisation.

nodes.name: Go tooling & modules
nodes.desc: go build, go run, go fmt, go vet and dependency management with modules.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build, run, format and vet Go code and manage dependencies with Go modules.

nodes.name: Slices & maps
nodes.desc: Arrays, slices and their backing arrays, maps and range loops.
nodes.summary: You will understand how slices share backing arrays and be able to use slices, maps and range loops correctly.

nodes.name: Structs & methods
nodes.desc: Structs, methods, pointer vs value receivers and embedding.
nodes.summary: You will be able to define structs with methods, choose between pointer and value receivers and reuse behaviour through embedding.

nodes.name: Interfaces
nodes.desc: Implicit interfaces, the empty interface, type switches and small interfaces.
nodes.summary: You will be able to design small interfaces that types satisfy implicitly and inspect dynamic types with type assertions and switches.

nodes.name: Errors
nodes.desc: Errors as values, wrapping, errors.Is/As, and panic and recover.
nodes.summary: You will be able to handle errors as ordinary values, wrap them with context and know when panic and recover are appropriate.

nodes.name: Generics
nodes.desc: Type parameters and constraints in Go.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write type-safe generic functions and types in Go using type parameters and constraints.

nodes.name: Goroutines
nodes.desc: Starting goroutines, the Go scheduler and WaitGroups.
nodes.summary: You will be able to run work concurrently with goroutines, wait for it with WaitGroups and understand how the Go scheduler works.

nodes.name: Channels
nodes.desc: Buffered and unbuffered channels, closing and ranging over channels.
nodes.summary: You will be able to pass data between goroutines with buffered and unbuffered channels and close and range over them safely.
topics: Closing channels and ranging over them

nodes.name: select & context
nodes.desc: Multiplexing with select, timeouts and cancellation with context.
nodes.summary: You will be able to wait on multiple channel operations with select and propagate timeouts and cancellation with context.

nodes.name: sync & races
nodes.desc: Mutexes, Once, atomic and finding data races with -race.
nodes.summary: You will be able to protect shared state with mutexes and atomics and detect data races with the race detector.

nodes.name: Worker pool project
nodes.desc: Build a concurrent worker pool that processes jobs with cancellation and error reporting.
nodes.summary: You will build a concurrent worker pool that distributes jobs, collects results, reports errors and stops cleanly on cancellation.

nodes.name: net/http
nodes.desc: HTTP servers and clients, handlers, middleware and routing in the standard library.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build HTTP servers and clients with the standard library, including handlers, routing and middleware.

nodes.name: JSON encoding
nodes.desc: Marshalling and unmarshalling JSON with struct tags.
nodes.summary: You will be able to convert between Go structs and JSON using encoding/json and control field mapping with struct tags.

nodes.name: database/sql
nodes.desc: Querying relational databases with database/sql and connection pooling.
nodes.summary: You will be able to query relational databases from Go with database/sql, scan results safely and tune the connection pool.
topics: Opening a database with a driver

nodes.name: Testing
nodes.desc: Table-driven tests, benchmarks, fuzzing and httptest.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write table-driven tests, benchmarks and fuzz tests in Go and test HTTP handlers with httptest.
topics: The testing package and go test

nodes.name: Profiling with pprof
nodes.desc: CPU and memory profiling and reading flame graphs.
nodes.summary: You will be able to profile CPU and memory usage of Go programs with pprof and read flame graphs to find hotspots.

nodes.name: Deploying Go
nodes.desc: Static binaries, small container images and configuration.
nodes.summary: You will be able to ship Go services as static binaries in small container images with configuration from the environment.

nodes.name: REST service project
nodes.desc: Build a tested REST service in Go with a database, graceful shutdown and a container image.
nodes.summary: You will build and containerise a tested REST service in Go backed by a database with graceful shutdown.
